desc: Introducing the WMD Guns 8.6 BO rifle. The round was designed and developed by Q using a .338 projectile, .308 bolt face, and modified 6.5 Creedmoor brass. The 8.6 BLK delivers a serious punch in both subsonic and supersonic loads thanks to its unique, super-fast 1:3 twist. The rifle comes with a ballistic nylon tactical carry bag and includes a box of Gorilla Ammunition 8.6 Blackout 300 gr Sierra MatchKing subsonic target ammo, optimized for either the 12" or 16" barrel. This platform features the same quality as WMD Guns' Big Beast 308 platform.
